    ppc64le - Fix deviation in floating point values caused by FMA (#91)
    
    This was exposed while testing CockroachDB.
    Following tests from pkg/sql/opt/exec/execbuilder fail due to floating point precision differences caused by FMA:
    - TestExecBuild/local/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/local-vec-off/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/local-spec-planning/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-vec-off/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-metadata/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-disk/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-spec-planning/geospatial
    
    With explicit casts in this patch, these failures are resolved.
    
    References:
    https://go.dev/ref/spec#Floating_point_operators
    https://github.com/golang/go/issues/53297
    https://github.com/golang/go/issues/48145
    https://github.com/disintegration/gift/issues/20#issuecomment-524551797
    
    Co-authored-by: Prashant Khoje <prashant.khoje@ibm.com>

+		return
+	}

+		}

+		if d.err != nil {
+			return
+		}
+		if numClipped == 0 {

+			return
+		}
+		if numClipped > maxClippedShapesPerCell {
+			d.err = fmt.Errorf("too many clipped shapes in cell (%d; max is %d)", numClipped, maxClippedShapesPerCell)
+			return
+		}

+		cell := &ShapeIndexCell{
+			shapes: make([]*clippedShape, 0, min(numClipped, 64)),

+			cShapeID := d.readInt32()

+			numEdges := d.readUint32()

+			}

+			}
+			if numEdges == 0 && !containsCenter {

+				return
+			}
+			if numEdges > maxEdgesPerClippedShape {

+			}

+			shapeNumEdges := shape.NumEdges()
+			edges := make([]int, 0, min(numEdges, 64))

+				}

+				containsCenter: containsCenter,
